t: Newspaper Clipping Magazine For Watchmen To Be Published Soon

pages.en:
THE CHINA PRESS, SATURDAY, APRIL 14, 1934

Magazine For Watchmen
To Be Published Soon

A magazine devoted to interests
of watchmen and bodyguards in
Shanghai, "On The Watch" will
shortly be published in the Eng-
lish, Russian and Chinese languages
The magazine will be published by
Colonel Houdiakoff and Colonel
Barabanov.
The journal will devote itself to
the interests of watchmen and body-
guards as well as employers of these
men and contributions will be re-
ceived with thanks and should be
sent to 808c Rue Lafayette.
pages.zh:
《字林西报》，1934年4月14日，星期六

巡捕杂志
即将出版

一份致力于上海巡捕及保镖利益的杂志《守望》（On The Watch）不久将以英文、俄文和中文出版。
该杂志将由胡迪亚科夫上校（Colonel Houdiakoff）和巴拉巴诺夫上校（Colonel Barabanov）出版。
该刊物将致力于维护巡捕和保镖以及这些人员的雇主的利益，欢迎投稿，稿件请寄至拉斐特路808c号（Rue Lafayette）。
